user_story.capability: to list its available backups
user_story.benefit: I can choose one to restore or evaluate backup coverage

criteria.trigger: a caller requests backups for a database handle
criteria.behavior: return the list of backups for that database, each including its identifier and creation timestamp

criteria.trigger: a caller requests backups with a maximum age filter
criteria.behavior: exclude backups older than that age from the returned list

criteria.trigger: the specified database handle does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the handle instead of returning an empty list

user_story.role: agent recovering from a bad deploy or data issue
user_story.capability: to restore a database from a specific backup
user_story.benefit: the database's data returns to a known-good point in time

criteria.trigger: a caller requests a restore for a valid backup identifier
criteria.behavior: start a restore operation and return the resulting new database resource once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: the restore operation fails
criteria.behavior: raise an error including the operation's failure message

criteria.trigger: the specified backup identifier does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the identifier instead of starting an operation

user_story.capability: to find and purge orphaned backups (backups whose source database no longer exists)
user_story.benefit: unused backups don't accumulate

criteria.trigger: a caller requests orphaned backups for an environment
criteria.behavior: return the list of backups in that environment whose source database has been deleted

criteria.trigger: a caller requests a purge for a specific backup identifier
criteria.behavior: delete that backup and return confirmation

criteria.trigger: the specified backup identifier does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the identifier

user_story.capability: to create, list, and remove log drains for an environment
user_story.benefit: application logs reach an external log store (e.g. Datadog, Papertrail, syslog)

criteria.trigger: a caller creates a log drain with a valid destination type and connection details
criteria.behavior: provision the drain and return the resulting resource, including its identifier and status

criteria.trigger: a caller lists log drains for an environment
criteria.behavior: return every log drain provisioned in that environment

criteria.trigger: a caller deprovisions a log drain by identifier
criteria.behavior: remove it and return confirmation

criteria.trigger: a log drain create request specifies an unsupported destination type
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the unsupported type instead of attempting provisioning

criteria.trigger: the specified log drain identifier does not exist on deprovision
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the identifier

user_story.capability: to create, list, and remove metric drains for an environment
user_story.benefit: container metrics reach an external monitoring service (e.g. Datadog, InfluxDB)

criteria.trigger: a caller creates a metric drain with a valid destination type and connection details
criteria.behavior: provision the drain and return the resulting resource, including its identifier and status

criteria.trigger: a caller lists metric drains for an environment
criteria.behavior: return every metric drain provisioned in that environment

criteria.trigger: a caller deprovisions a metric drain by identifier
criteria.behavior: remove it and return confirmation

criteria.trigger: a metric drain create request specifies an unsupported destination type
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the unsupported type instead of attempting provisioning

criteria.trigger: the specified metric drain identifier does not exist on deprovision
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the identifier

user_story.capability: to create an endpoint bound to my own domain with Aptible-managed TLS
user_story.benefit: traffic to my domain reaches the app over HTTPS without me sourcing a certificate myself

criteria.trigger: a caller creates an endpoint for a service specifying a custom domain and requesting managed TLS
criteria.behavior: provision the endpoint and return the resulting resource, including any DNS validation records required to complete provisioning

criteria.trigger: the specified service does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the service instead of attempting provisioning

criteria.trigger: the specified domain is an apex domain that Aptible's managed TLS does not support
criteria.behavior: raise an error explaining the restriction instead of attempting provisioning

user_story.role: agent exposing an app publicly with an existing certificate
user_story.capability: to create an endpoint using a certificate I supply
user_story.benefit: I retain control over my own TLS material

criteria.trigger: a caller uploads a certificate and private key
criteria.behavior: store the certificate and return its identifier and fingerprint

criteria.trigger: a caller creates an endpoint referencing a stored certificate's fingerprint
criteria.behavior: provision the endpoint using that certificate

criteria.trigger: a caller lists certificates for the environment
criteria.behavior: return every stored certificate with its identifier and expiration date

criteria.trigger: the supplied certificate and private key do not form a valid pair
criteria.behavior: raise an error instead of storing the certificate

criteria.trigger: an endpoint create request references a certificate fingerprint that does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the fingerprint instead of attempting provisioning

user_story.capability: to create TCP, TLS, or gRPC endpoints (not just default HTTPS)
user_story.benefit: I can expose services that don't speak HTTP/1.1

criteria.trigger: a caller creates an endpoint specifying type TCP, TLS, or gRPC along with the container ports to expose
criteria.behavior: provision an endpoint of that type bound to those ports

criteria.trigger: a caller lists endpoints for a service
criteria.behavior: include each endpoint's type in the returned resource

criteria.trigger: a TLS-type endpoint create request omits a certificate reference
criteria.behavior: raise an error instead of attempting provisioning

user_story.role: agent that needs external clients to reach a database directly
user_story.capability: to create an endpoint that exposes a database (rather than an app service)
user_story.benefit: authorized external clients can connect to it

criteria.trigger: a caller creates a database endpoint for a valid database handle
criteria.behavior: provision the endpoint and return its resulting hostname and port

criteria.trigger: the specified database handle does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the handle instead of attempting provisioning

user_story.capability: to modify its configuration or trigger a TLS renewal
user_story.benefit: I don't have to delete and recreate the endpoint for routine changes

criteria.trigger: a caller modifies an existing endpoint's supported settings (e.g. container ports, certificate reference)
criteria.behavior: apply the change and return the updated resource

criteria.trigger: a caller triggers a TLS renewal for a managed-TLS app endpoint
criteria.behavior: start the renewal operation and return its resulting status

criteria.trigger: the specified endpoint identifier does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the identifier instead of attempting the change

user_story.capability: to rename an app
user_story.benefit: its handle reflects current naming conventions without recreating the app

criteria.trigger: a caller renames an app to a new handle that is unique within its environment
criteria.behavior: apply the new handle and return the updated resource

criteria.trigger: the requested new handle is already in use within the same environment
criteria.behavior: raise an error instead of applying the rename

criteria.trigger: the specified app does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the app instead of attempting the rename

user_story.capability: to trigger a deploy of a new Docker image (or Git reference) to an app
user_story.benefit: the app runs the new version without me leaving the session

criteria.trigger: a caller triggers a deploy specifying a new Docker image reference
criteria.behavior: start a deploy operation and return the resulting app resource once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: the deploy operation fails
criteria.behavior: raise an error including the operation's failure message

criteria.trigger: the specified app does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the app instead of starting a deploy

user_story.role: agent responding to a base-image security patch
user_story.capability: to trigger a rebuild of an app's current release
user_story.benefit: the app picks up underlying image layer updates without a new deploy

criteria.trigger: a caller triggers a rebuild for an app
criteria.behavior: start a rebuild operation and return the resulting app resource once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: the rebuild operation fails
criteria.behavior: raise an error including the operation's failure message

user_story.role: agent recovering from a stuck or misbehaving app
user_story.capability: to restart it
user_story.benefit: its containers restart without a full deploy

criteria.trigger: a caller triggers a restart for an app
criteria.behavior: start a restart operation and return the resulting app resource once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: the restart operation fails
criteria.behavior: raise an error including the operation's failure message

user_story.role: agent tuning a service's runtime behavior
user_story.capability: to read and update service-level settings (e.g. health check command, zero-downtime deploys)
user_story.benefit: I can adjust behavior per service without recreating it

criteria.trigger: a caller requests a service's settings
criteria.behavior: return the current value of each supported setting

criteria.trigger: a caller updates one or more supported service settings
criteria.behavior: apply the changes and return the updated settings

criteria.trigger: a caller attempts to set an unsupported setting name
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the unsupported setting instead of applying any change

user_story.role: agent that started an operation in error (or one running too long)
user_story.capability: to cancel an in-progress operation
user_story.benefit: it stops without waiting for it to time out or succeed/fail on its own

criteria.trigger: a caller cancels an operation that is still queued or running
criteria.behavior: request cancellation and return the operation's resulting status

criteria.trigger: the specified operation has already reached a terminal state (`succeeded` or `failed`)
criteria.behavior: raise an error explaining that it cannot be cancelled instead of requesting cancellation

criteria.trigger: the specified operation identifier does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the identifier

user_story.capability: to rename an environment
user_story.benefit: its handle reflects current naming conventions without recreating the environment

criteria.trigger: a caller renames an environment to a new handle that is unique within the organization
criteria.behavior: apply the new handle and return the updated resource

criteria.trigger: the requested new handle is already in use
criteria.behavior: raise an error instead of applying the rename

criteria.trigger: the specified environment does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the environment instead of attempting the rename

user_story.capability: to create a read replica of an existing database
user_story.benefit: read traffic can be served without adding load to the primary

criteria.trigger: a caller requests a replica of an existing database with a handle and environment
criteria.behavior: start a replication operation and return the resulting replica database resource once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: the replication operation fails
criteria.behavior: raise an error including the operation's failure message

criteria.trigger: the specified source database does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the database instead of starting replication

user_story.role: agent setting up a staging copy
user_story.capability: to clone a database into a new, independent database
user_story.benefit: I can test against realistic data without touching the source

criteria.trigger: a caller requests a clone of an existing database into a new handle
criteria.behavior: start a clone operation and return the resulting new database resource once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: the clone operation fails
criteria.behavior: raise an error including the operation's failure message

criteria.trigger: the requested new handle is already in use within the target environment
criteria.behavior: raise an error instead of starting the clone

user_story.role: agent managing an existing database's configuration
user_story.capability: to modify its IOPS/volume type, change its container size or disk size, reload it, rename it, or restart it
user_story.benefit: I can adjust an existing database without recreating it

criteria.trigger: a caller modifies a database's provisioned IOPS or EBS volume type
criteria.behavior: start a modify operation and return the resulting database resource once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: a caller changes a database's container size, disk size, or container profile
criteria.behavior: start a restart operation carrying the new values and return the resulting database resource once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: a caller reloads a database
criteria.behavior: start a reload operation and return the resulting status once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: a caller renames a database to a handle that is unique within its environment
criteria.behavior: apply the new handle and return the updated resource

criteria.trigger: a caller restarts a database without changing its size
criteria.behavior: start a restart operation and return the resulting status once the operation succeeds

criteria.trigger: any of the above operations fails
criteria.behavior: raise an error including the operation's failure message

criteria.trigger: the requested new handle in a rename is already in use within the same environment
criteria.behavior: raise an error instead of applying the rename

user_story.capability: to list the database versions available for a given database type
user_story.benefit: I know what upgrade targets exist before modifying a database

criteria.trigger: a caller requests available versions for a database type
criteria.behavior: return the list of supported versions for that type

criteria.trigger: the specified database type does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the type instead of returning an empty list

user_story.capability: to see which apps or databases are currently in maintenance mode
user_story.benefit: I know not to treat their unavailability as an incident

criteria.trigger: a caller lists apps or databases currently in maintenance mode for an environment
criteria.behavior: return that list

criteria.trigger: the specified environment does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the environment instead of returning an empty list

user_story.role: agent configuring private networking or mutual TLS for an environment
user_story.capability: to view the environment's configured CA certificate
user_story.benefit: I can confirm dependent connections trust the correct certificate authority

criteria.trigger: a caller requests an environment's current CA certificate
criteria.behavior: return it if one is configured

criteria.trigger: the specified environment does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the environment instead of returning a certificate

user_story.role: agent performing a one-time task inside a running app's container (e.g. a script or diagnostic command)
user_story.capability: to run a single command and get its output back
user_story.benefit: I can complete the task without an interactive shell session

criteria.trigger: a caller submits a command to run against a specific service of an existing app
criteria.behavior: start a one-off run operation and return the command's captured output once the operation completes

criteria.trigger: the one-off run operation fails
criteria.behavior: raise an error including the operation's failure message and any captured output

criteria.trigger: the specified app or service does not exist
criteria.behavior: raise an error naming the missing resource instead of starting the operation

user_story.role: agent invoking any new operation-triggering tool from Tiers 1–3
user_story.capability: long-running operations resolved before the tool call returns
user_story.benefit: I always get a final success/failure result rather than a bare in-progress operation reference

criteria.trigger: any Tier 1–3 tool starts an Aptible operation
criteria.behavior: wait for that operation to reach a terminal state before returning, using the same resolution mechanism as `wait_for_operation` in [`api_client.py`](../../api_client.py)

criteria.trigger: an operation does not reach a terminal state within the API's own timeout behavior
criteria.behavior: raise an error rather than returning an ambiguous partial result
